import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, flow, capacity, cost, rev;
        Edge(int to, int flow, int capacity, int cost, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int n;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        int[] dist, curFlow, pre, preEdge, prevNode, potential;

        FlowNetwork(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            dist = new int[n];
            curFlow = new int[n];
            pre = new int[n];
            preEdge = new int[n];
            prevNode = new int[n];
            potential = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cst) {
            Edge a = new Edge(t, 0, cap, cst, adj.get(t).size());
            Edge b = new Edge(s, 0, 0, -cst, adj.get(s).size());
            adj.get(s).add(a);
            adj.get(t).add(b);
        }

        int[] getMinCostMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int totalFlow = 0, totalCost = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
                pq.offer(new int[]{0, s});
                dist[s] = 0;
                curFlow[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] top = pq.poll();
                    int d = top[0], u = top[1];
                    if (d != dist[u]) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                        int v = e.to;
                        if (e.flow >= e.capacity) continue;
                        int newDist = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[v];
                        if (dist[v] > newDist) {
                            dist[v] = newDist;
                            pq.offer(new int[]{newDist, v});
                            prevNode[v] = u;
                            preEdge[v] = i;
                            curFlow[v] = Math.min(curFlow[u], e.capacity - e.flow);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
                int df = curFlow[t];
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNode[v]) {
                    Edge e = adj.get(prevNode[v]).get(preEdge[v]);
                    e.flow += df;
                    adj.get(v).get(e.rev).flow -= df;
                    totalCost += df * e.cost;
                }
                totalFlow += df;
            }
            return new int[]{totalFlow, totalCost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int size = 6 + 107 * n;
        FlowNetwork network = new FlowNetwork(size);

        for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            network.addEdge(0, 1 + x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            y--;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 104; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= 50; j++) {
                    network.addEdge(1 + i * n + x, 1 + (i + 1) * n + y, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    network.addEdge(1 + i * n + y, 1 + (i + 1) * n + x, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 104; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                network.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, 51, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 104; i++) {
            network.addEdge(1 + i * n, 1 + 105 * n, 51, 0);
        }

        int[] result = network.getMinCostMaxFlow(0, 1 + 105 * n);
        System.out.println(result[1]);
    }
}
